prompt.description: Detailed description of the image to generate. Be specific about style, mood, composition, lighting, etc.

provider.description: Image generation provider. 'openai' uses DALL-E (default), 'google' uses Gemini/Imagen (Nano Banana).

size.description: Image dimensions. DALL-E 3 supports 1024x1024, 1792x1024, 1024x1792. DALL-E 2 supports 256x256, 512x512, 1024x1024. Default: 1024x1024

quality.description: Image quality (DALL-E 3 only). 'hd' creates more detailed images but takes longer. Default: standard

style.description: Image style (DALL-E 3 only). 'vivid' is more dramatic and artistic, 'natural' is more realistic. Default: vivid

model.description: Model to use (Google only). Examples: 'gemini-2.0-flash-exp' (Nano Banana, fast, free), 'imagen-3.0-generate-001'. Default: gemini-2.0-flash-exp

number_of_images.description: Number of images to generate (Google only, 1-4). Default: 1

save_as_asset.description: If true, automatically saves the generated image as a story asset. Default: false

story_id.description: Story ID to associate the asset with (required if save_as_asset is true)

asset_id.description: Custom asset ID. If not provided, auto-generates one.

asset_description.description: Description of what the asset shows (used in story metadata)
